Bleeding Wound.description: Starting at 2nd level, when an invisible blade lands a successful dagger sneak attack, he may opt to inflict a bleeding wound by forfeiting 1d6 points of the sneak attack's bonus damage. The initial strike deals its normal damage on the round it connects. From that point forward, the wound continues to bleed for 1 point of damage each round. Multiple bleeding wounds stack their damage (two wounds deal 2 points per round, and so forth). The bleeding can be halted only with a DC 15 Heal check or by applying any cure or other healing spell. Creatures that are immune to sneak attack damage cannot be affected by bleeding wounds.

Dagger Sneak Attack.description: An invisible blade acquires the sneak attack capability if he does not already possess it, though the bonus damage is restricted to attacks made with a dagger, kukri, or punching dagger (the GM may permit other comparable weapons). When executing a sneak attack with one of these weapons, he inflicts an additional 1d6 points of damage at 1st level, increasing to 2d6 at 3rd level and 3d6 at 5th level. If the character already has sneak attack from another class, the extra damage bonuses stack.

Feint Mastery.description: At 4th level, when armed with a dagger, kukri, or punching dagger, an invisible blade has become so confident in his ability to deceive foes that he may take 10 on any Bluff check made to feint in combat, even under conditions of stress or distraction that would normally prevent doing so.

Uncanny Feint.description: At 3rd level, an invisible blade can perform a feint in combat as a move action instead of a standard action. Upon reaching 5th level, he can feint as a free action. This ability is only available while the invisible blade is wielding a dagger, kukri, or punching dagger.

Unfettered Defense.description: An invisible blade develops heightened combat instincts that sharpen his defensive awareness. Thanks to this intuitive sense, he adds 1 point of his Intelligence bonus (if any) per invisible blade class level to his Armor Class, on top of any other applicable modifiers. If the invisible blade is flat-footed or otherwise unable to apply his Dexterity bonus to AC, he loses this benefit as well. This ability only functions when the invisible blade wears no armor and wields only daggers, kukris, or punching daggers.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Members of this prestige class do not gain proficiency with any additional weapons or armor.
